task: Decide whether this posting is relevant to the job seeker (relevant or not_relevant), naming the résumé fields and posting fields behind your verdict. Location and sponsorship are out of scope.

1_paste.result:
# Verdict: **relevant**

This is a hands-on data pipeline role at the right level, and it uses the candidate's core stack. The main gap is enterprise application integration (MuleSoft and SaaS APIs), which is a qualifications question, not a sign the role is off-target.

## Résumé fields and posting fields behind the verdict

| Résumé field | Posting field | Match |
|---|---|---|
| `target_titles`: "Data Integration", "Data Engineer", "ETL" | `title`: "Data & Integration Engineer, Business Systems" | Strong. The title combines two of the target titles. |
| `skills`: Python, SQL, Snowflake | `content` (What you'll do): "batch and incremental data pipelines into Snowflake, using SQL and Python" | Strong. These are the core required skills. |
| `skills`: dbt, Airflow, AWS, Kafka | `content` (nice-to-haves): "dbt, Airflow… streaming pipelines… AWS services such as S3, Lambda, and SQS" | Strong. These cover most of the preferred skills. |
| `experience[1]`: SQL/dbt models in Snowflake for sales reporting; ETL maintenance | `content`: "data models and datasets that support business operations, reconciliation, and reporting" | Good. This is similar business-reporting data modeling. |
| `experience[0]`: batch + streaming pipelines, Airflow orchestration | `content`: "production data pipelines," "change data capture, streaming pipelines… historical backfills" | Good. |
| `seniority`: 5 years, mid-to-senior IC, full-time | `content`: "5+ years," "hands-on individual contributor role," "full time role" | Match. The experience dates (2019-07 to 2024-08) add up to about 5 years. |

## Gaps (they weaken the fit but don't make the role irrelevant)

- **API-led enterprise integration.** The posting requires "MuleSoft, APIs, and event-driven architectures" and "integrating enterprise business applications across Finance, GTM, or People systems" (Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday). Nothing in `skills` or `experience` shows MuleSoft or SaaS API integration work. This is the largest gap, because the posting says it wants both integration *and* data pipeline delivery.
- **Leadership expectations.** The posting asks the candidate to "lead design reviews, mentor engineers," which is at the senior end of the stated `seniority` range.
- **Domain.** Finance, quote-to-cash, and SOX/ITGC experience is listed only as a plus, so it doesn't count against the verdict.

Location and sponsorship were left out of the assessment, as you asked.

2_file.result:
**Verdict: relevant.** It's a strong match on the data-engineering half of the role, with one real gap on the integration side.

**What lines up**

| Résumé field | Posting field | Match |
|---|---|---|
| `target_titles`: "Data Engineer", "Data Integration", "ETL" | `title`: "Data & Integration Engineer, Business Systems" | Direct title match |
| `seniority`: mid-level to senior IC, 5 years, full-time only | `content`: "hands-on individual contributor role", "5+ years of relevant engineering experience", "This is a full time role" | Fits. The résumé's `experience` covers 2019-07 to 2024-08, which is about 5 years. |
| `skills`: Snowflake, SQL, Python, dbt | `content` (What you'll do): "batch and incremental data pipelines into Snowflake, using SQL and Python"; requirement for "Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse, including data modeling" | Core match |
| `skills`: Airflow, dbt, Kafka, AWS | `content` (nice-to-haves): "dbt, Airflow…change data capture, streaming pipelines"; "AWS services such as S3, Lambda, and SQS" | Covers most of the nice-to-haves |
| `experience[0].summary`: "batch and streaming pipelines…orchestrated with Airflow on AWS" | `content`: "production data pipelines", "batch and incremental data pipelines" | Directly relevant |
| `experience[1].summary`: "SQL and dbt models in Snowflake for sales reporting" | `content`: "data models and datasets that support business operations, reconciliation, and reporting" | Close match. Sales reporting is related to GTM data. |

**The gap**

- The posting asks for "hands-on delivery of **both** enterprise integrations and production data pipelines." It also asks for "API-led integrations" built with MuleSoft and event-driven architectures, and for integrating Salesforce, NetSuite and Workday across "Finance, GTM, or People systems."
- None of that appears in the résumé's `skills` or `experience`. There's no MuleSoft, no API or integration work, and no CRM, ERP or HR systems. The résumé also doesn't mention the nice-to-haves Workday Studio, Apex, SuiteScript or SOX/ITGC.

**Why it's still relevant:** The title is one of the seeker's targets, and seniority and employment type fit. The data-pipeline requirements are about half the role, and the seeker meets nearly all of them, plus most of the nice-to-haves. The posting also says "If…your past experience doesn't align perfectly…we encourage you to apply anyways." The integration gap could hurt their chances, but it doesn't make the role off-target. The seeker should expect to be asked about API and integration experience.

I didn't consider location or `needs_sponsorship`, as you asked.

I've reached a verdict on posting 6233040004, but **state.json has not been written.** The save was blocked: the folder path uses a shortened Windows form (`AKSHIT~1`), and the permission check won't allow that without your manual approval.

## Verdict: **relevant**

**Posting 6233040004:** Data & Integration Engineer, Business Systems (Business Operations). Full time, individual contributor, 5+ years.

| Résumé field | Posting field | Match |
|---|---|---|
| `target_titles`: "Data Engineer", "Data Integration", "ETL" | `title`: "Data & Integration Engineer"; the role is described as application integration combined with data engineering | Strong: lines up with two of your target titles |
| `skills`: Python, SQL, Snowflake | Responsibilities: "batch and incremental pipelines into Snowflake using SQL and Python"; required: Snowflake or a similar cloud warehouse | Strong: core requirements |
| `skills`: dbt, Airflow, Kafka, AWS | Preferred: dbt, Airflow, streaming/CDC, AWS (S3, Lambda, SQS) | Strong: covers almost all the preferred skills |
| `seniority`: mid-to-senior IC, 5 yrs, full time | "5+ years", full time, individual contributor | Matches: about 5 years from 2019-07 to 2024-08 |
| `experience[0].summary`: batch and streaming pipelines, Airflow on AWS | Required: "production data pipelines"; preferred: streaming | Strong |
| `experience[1].summary`: SQL/dbt in Snowflake, sales reporting, ETL | "data models… for operations, reconciliation, and reporting" and GTM systems | Good |

**Gaps (worth noting, but they don't change the verdict):**
- The required "API-led integrations" (auth, retries, idempotency) and the MuleSoft/CRM/ERP/HR integration work don't appear anywhere in the résumé.
- Integrating Finance, GTM or People systems is also required. Sales reporting at Lakeview only partly covers this.
- The 5+ years has to count enterprise *integrations* as well as pipelines, so you only just meet the bar.
- The SOX/ITGC, Workday, Apex and NetSuite items are all preferred, and none appear in the résumé.

As you asked, I left out location and sponsorship.

## state.json
I collected all 140 posting IDs on the board, which matches the board's `meta.total` of 140. I pulled the list twice and both runs agreed, but a summarising tool did the extraction, so the IDs weren't checked by an actual JSON parse. For the same reason, I read posting 6233040004 from its single-job page rather than the full `?content=true` feed, which was too large (about 1.6M characters). To get the file saved, either approve the write when asked or give me the full path to the folder (with the full username instead of `AKSHIT~1`), and I'll write it. The file holds the board name, source URL, fetch date, total, and the `job_ids` array.
